m = primitives.call(name='move_robowits_ee_to', arm='right', target_position=[0.855, -0.100, 0.830], gripper_width=0.0, evidence_handles=["robowits:visual:0","robowits:visual:2"], max_steps=96, max_translation=0.06)
print(m.ok)
if m.ok:
    o = m.output
    print({k: o.get(k) for k in ['target_reached','position_reached','final_position','ee_position'] if isinstance(o, dict)})
    print(str(o)[:800])
else:
    print(m.output)
